n01: Why does a business need a moat? <#0.35#> Because rivals keep attacking any castle that earns well. <#0.2#> Buffett wrote that in his letter for two thousand seven.

n03: Buffett's picture: a crowd at a parade. <#0.2#> One person stands on tiptoe to see better. <#0.2#> Then everyone does. <#0.2#> Nobody sees better. <#0.2#> Our reading: that is life without a moat.
